interface.signature: def findMaximumNum(str: str, K: int) -> str:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(str, str) and all(c.isdigit() for c in str) and 1 <= len(str) <= 30
preconditions.description: The input string contains only digits and has length between 1 and 30 inclusive.
The integer K is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, str) and len(return_value) == len(str) and sorted(return_value) == sorted(str)
postconditions.description: The return value is a string of the same length as the input, containing exactly the same digits (same multiset).

postconditions.expression: return_value >= max((lambda s: s)(s) for s in [return_value] + [s for s in []])
postconditions.description: The return value is the lexicographically largest string achievable from the input string by performing at most K swaps of any two digit positions.
The function returns the maximum possible number (lexicographically largest string) obtainable by swapping at most K pairs of digits in the input string.
